name: Trades Online
who: Dutch installers, electricians, painters, cleaners and small building firms with one to ten staff, whose website was built once and never touched again.
problem: "My site is from 2019 and my nephew made it. I get work from word of mouth, but when someone searches for what I do, they find three other guys first."
solution: The delivery system Vision Outreach Media already runs, pointed at the trades: a fast site that asks for the job, technical SEO for the handful of searches that actually bring work, a Google Business Profile that is complete and reviewed, and a monthly care plan that keeps all of it moving.
promise: When somebody searches for the work you do, they find three other firms first. A site that ranks for the jobs you want and asks for the enquiry, live in three weeks and looked after every month after that.
gets:
A fast, mobile-first site built around the jobs you want more of
Technical SEO and a complete Google Business Profile, with reviews coming in monthly
A care plan at €125/month: hosting, updates, content, reporting
positioning: The same build system with live proof behind it — a 96/100 PageSpeed site, a working analytics and consent stack — sold to a market that decides in one conversation instead of a committee.
voice: Straight talking, no agency language. Prices on the page, timeline on the page.
channels: Google search for Dutch trade keywords, trade wholesalers, local Facebook groups, vakbeurzen, referral from existing clients
